answer_2.quote: We introduce a novel automatic evaluation framework, CUA-as-a-Judge... The judge interacts directly with the game environment... thereby verifying the accomplishment of necessary milestones.

answer_3.quote: CUA-as-a-Judge, implemented using Claude-3.7-Sonnet computer-use... functions as an oracle with direct access to success milestones... verifying the accomplishment of necessary milestones.

answer_4.quote: We recruited 13 participants to play through all 34 games... participants completed full story arcs with an average of 1,142 steps... demonstrating that the games can be fully solved within practical time limits.
answer_4.guideline: Collected gameplay demonstrations including input logs and screen recordings; evaluated based on predefined milestones
